description: The Mac's `make test` inside `nix develop`, classified from the 1cadaf4 record (172 skips) on 2026-09-30. naga has no rule: the dev shell provides it from stage2/nix (e74a3cc), so a naga skip is unexpected again. lldb has no rule either: the debug adapter resolves Apple's lldb without the shell's DEVELOPER_DIR and SDKROOT (stage2/lldbenv), so on a developer-mode Mac a DAP session skip is unexpected; only developer mode being off is expected. pugixml, sqlite3 and the native compiler provider have no rule since stage4/tools-ci (88a5c36) gave the Darwin dev shells pugixml, sqlite.dev and BTRC_NATIVE_PROVIDER_CC/CXX: macOS run 36934014516 ran every C++ owner, SQLite, compiler-context, receipt and consumer case, so their skips are unexpected again.

rules.reason: ^needs macOS developer mode for lldb to launch an inferior
rules.note: LldbBootstrap.debugger_access_available() found developer mode off, so lldb cannot launch an inferior without an authorization prompt. macos.yml enables it for the unit shard, where the four DAP sessions run; the devcontainer skips them.
Nix gcc on macOS has no libasan, and clang's ASan+UBSan runtime does not start under the dev shell; the devcontainer runs both witnesses.
windows.yml runs test_artifact_storage.py on a native Windows host.
windows.yml runs test_bootstrap_harness.py before its native bootstrap.
macOS resolves the cache under ~/Library/Caches; the XDG branch is Linux behavior.
These cases link ELF objects with the Linux toolchain.

rules.reason: ^compiler wrapper does not provide its UBSan runtime$
rules.note: The macOS compiler wrapper ships no UBSan runtime.
ThreadSanitizer crashes on an independent exact-flags probe on this host.

rules.reason: ^requires Linux and the explicitly built native header reader$
rules.note: Image decoding, FreeType rasterization and audio fault injection need no display or PCM, the devcontainer's image installs a null default PCM (nix/asound.conf) for the audio sessions, and CI runs every Linux shard under tools/virtual-display.sh (Xvfb and Mesa lavapipe) for the GUI windows and the GPU view, so the devcontainer runs all seven.

rules.reason: ^the (FreeType proof builds against the Linux SDK|macro proof builds against the Linux C toolchain|WebGPU proof builds against the Linux SDK)$
rules.note: The macro-constant proofs build against the Linux dev shell's C toolchain, freetype2 (pkg-config) and WebGPU headers; the devcontainer's unit shard runs both frontends (CI run 36935218617 for FreeType).

rules.reason: ^requires Linux and the explicitly built native header reader$
rules.note: The tray also needs a StatusNotifierItem watcher on a session bus, which the devcontainer lacks.
The configured-PCM capability cases run wherever ALSA headers exist.
